findings.evidence: Raw events contain 30 Brighton shot-producing corner sequences but 32 shots, and 86 Leverkusen sequences but 91 shots.
findings.reproduction: Count corners with at least one shot in the sequence and compare with sum of sequence shot counts.
findings.actual_behavior: shot_rate was total shots divided by corner count.
findings.expected_behavior: Conversion is shot-producing corner sequences divided by corner count.
findings.root_cause: The grouped numerator summed shots rather than boolean sequence outcomes.
findings.impact: Rebounds inflated a stakeholder-facing effectiveness percentage.
findings.resolution: Added corners_with_shot and separated conversion from total shots.
findings.verification: Regression test covers two shots from one corner; both real bundles were independently recounted.

findings.evidence: The end_x < 108 proxy labeled long deliveries, including a 39.97-unit outswinging pass, as short.
findings.reproduction: Create a 40-unit corner ending at x=105 and inspect delivery_type.
findings.actual_behavior: The delivery was short because of end x.
findings.expected_behavior: The delivery is direct; missing length is unknown.
findings.root_cause: An undocumented coordinate proxy was ORed with the length threshold.
findings.impact: Routine group counts and claims were wrong.
findings.resolution: Use only first-delivery length <= 15 and document the rule.
findings.verification: Regression test passes; corrected groups are Brighton 3 and Leverkusen 8.

findings.evidence: A non-zero mean change with zero pooled variance returned math.inf.
findings.reproduction: Compare constant baseline values of 2 with constant recent values of 12.
findings.actual_behavior: Infinite Hedges g could pass magnitude gates and json.dumps emitted non-standard Infinity.
findings.expected_behavior: Undefined effect is explicit and suppressed.
findings.root_cause: Zero variance was treated as infinite evidence.
findings.impact: Potential false publication and invalid strict JSON.
findings.resolution: Represent undefined effect as null and add a suppression reason.
findings.verification: Numerical regression and strict JSON parsing tests pass.

findings.evidence: An identical rebuild changed bundle.json and report.html only because of generated_at.
findings.reproduction: Run both case builds twice and compare hashes.
findings.expected_behavior: Pinned analytical outputs are byte reproducible.
findings.root_cause: Wall-clock metadata was embedded in outputs.
findings.impact: Noisy diffs and weakened reproducibility claims.
findings.resolution: Removed runtime timestamps and display the pinned source revision.
findings.verification: All 16 case artifact hashes match across repeated builds.

findings.evidence: Initial coverage was 64%; pipeline and visuals were 0%, adapter 35%, and no CI workflow existed.
findings.reproduction: Run pytest with coverage on the initial revision.
findings.actual_behavior: 15 passing tests did not execute the real build path.
findings.expected_behavior: Critical analytical and generation paths have regression coverage.
findings.root_cause: Tests focused on isolated functions and committed snapshots.
findings.impact: Passing tests could miss broken builds or stale outputs.
findings.resolution: Added 8 tests, deterministic pipeline coverage, failure cases, and GitHub Actions.

findings.evidence: A truncated cached JSON file raised JSONDecodeError without reacquisition.
findings.reproduction: Write invalid JSON at a cache path and call _get_json.
findings.actual_behavior: The build failed on the stale file.
findings.root_cause: Cache reads were trusted and writes were direct.
findings.impact: Interrupted downloads could permanently break local builds.
findings.resolution: Recover corrupt entries and atomically replace temporary downloads.

findings.evidence: config.slug was joined directly beneath output_root.
findings.actual_behavior: The output path could escape its root.
findings.impact: A malicious local config could overwrite files writable by the process.
findings.resolution: Restrict slugs and validate all numeric minima.

findings.evidence: Browser semantics exposed chart images as alt=0, the hero as a generic div, and accent contrast ratios of 2.56 and 2.75 on paper.
findings.reproduction: Inspect the live DOM and calculate WCAG contrast.
findings.actual_behavior: Screen-reader labels were meaningless and small accents failed AA.
findings.expected_behavior: Descriptive alternatives, h1 semantics, and at least 4.5:1 small-text contrast.
findings.root_cause: Default st.image output and presentation-first colors.
findings.resolution: Added semantic image markup, h1, darker teal/coral, and mobile title rules.
findings.verification: New contrast ratios exceed 4.5:1 and app tests pass.

findings.evidence: Count metrics and xG shared one raw numeric axis.
findings.reproduction: Open the initial Briefing chart and compare xG with count bars.
findings.actual_behavior: Cross-metric bar length implied comparability between different units.
findings.expected_behavior: Cross-metric comparison uses a common scale.
findings.root_cause: Raw baseline and recent values were grouped across heterogeneous metrics.
findings.resolution: Chart standardized effects and annotate original values and units.
findings.verification: Both case charts regenerated and visually reviewed.

findings.evidence: Render reports buildCommand pip install ., startCommand streamlit ..., and an empty healthCheckPath, while render.yaml defines locked setup and /_stcore/health.
findings.reproduction: Compare Render service details with render.yaml.
findings.actual_behavior: The live service was created outside the canonical Blueprint and has drift.
findings.expected_behavior: Live settings match reviewed infrastructure configuration.
findings.root_cause: Service creation and later Blueprint documentation were separate workflows.
findings.impact: Repository changes to deployment settings do not reconcile the existing service.
findings.resolution: Canonical Blueprint now uses uv.lock and the Streamlit health endpoint.
findings.verification: Repository configuration validated; live setting reconciliation remains manual.

findings.evidence: The free Render instance displayed a cold-start interstitial and needed about 30 seconds before the app became interactive.
findings.reproduction: Open the service after it has spun down.
findings.expected_behavior: A portfolio demo opens quickly during outreach.
findings.impact: A reviewer may abandon the demo before it loads.
findings.resolution: Documented as a hosting trade-off; no paid resource was provisioned.
findings.verification: Warm app is functional and Render logs contain no errors.

findings.evidence: The internal contract allows missing endpoints and xG, while affected metric sums can be lower without metric-level suppression.
findings.reproduction: Pass a shot without xG or a movement without end coordinates.
findings.actual_behavior: Validation originally exposed only missing start locations.
findings.expected_behavior: Affected metrics are diagnosed and eventually suppressed by completeness rules.
findings.root_cause: Dataset validation was not connected to per-metric quality gates.
findings.impact: A different provider or malformed source could create understated metrics.
findings.resolution: Added explicit missing endpoint, xG, and corner-length diagnostics.
findings.verification: Diagnostics regression passes; per-metric publication gating remains roadmap work.

findings.evidence: Both real-data bundles now expose recent and previous-window routine shares, bootstrap intervals, quality percentages, stability labels, and representative evidence IDs.
findings.reproduction: Rebuild both case bundles, recompute routine shares independently from SP evidence sequences, and compare exported briefing values.
findings.actual_behavior: A configurable within-team baseline is available and uses all window corners as the denominator.
findings.expected_behavior: Published routine observations must be comparative, uncertain, stable enough to review, and evidence-linked.
findings.root_cause: The MVP only presented absolute routine inventories.
findings.impact: Analysts previously lacked an opponent-preparation comparison context.
findings.resolution: Added the opponent comparison layer, quality gates, stability labels, filtered evidence room, and deterministic briefing export.
findings.verification: 27 tests pass, both real bundles rebuild, strict JSON parsing passes, and independent routine share recomputation matches the comparison layer.

findings.actual_behavior: Two teams validate configuration portability within one provider.
findings.expected_behavior: Claims remain limited to architectural readiness for another adapter.
findings.root_cause: A second licensed provider dataset is not available.
findings.impact: Provider-neutral wording can be overstated if not qualified.
findings.resolution: Documentation states that additional providers can be added later and avoids unsupported compatibility claims.
findings.verification: No club names occur in analytical logic; provider claims are qualified.

findings.evidence: The two real bundles contain 126 Brighton and 310 Leverkusen supported dead-ball sequences across four explicit categories.
findings.reproduction: Recount raw StatsBomb Pass and Shot events using the documented subtype and final-third location rules.
findings.actual_behavior: Independent counts match Brighton 92 corners, 19 wide free kicks, 11 indirect free kicks, 4 direct free kicks and Leverkusen 236, 40, 13, 21.
findings.expected_behavior: A category must be reproducible and must disclose that free-kick labels are location buckets.
findings.root_cause: The former product exposed only corner routines.
findings.impact: The product would otherwise overstate domain coverage and analyst usefulness.
findings.resolution: Added DeadBallSequence, four supported categories, first-contact and second-phase fields, quality gates, and capability labels.
findings.verification: Raw-event recount matched both bundles; 29 tests pass and artifacts are strict JSON.

findings.evidence: Current case bundles do not load a complete comparable peer feature matrix.
findings.reproduction: Inspect dead_ball_lab.ml in both generated bundles.
findings.actual_behavior: The interpretable profile feature vector is retained, but clustering is suppressed with a coverage reason.
findings.expected_behavior: ML must not appear as a tactical discovery claim without peer coverage, stability, and evidence.
findings.root_cause: The legitimate source bundle is selected-team coverage rather than a complete competition dead-ball sample.
findings.impact: Publishing a cluster would create false precision.
findings.resolution: Added a deterministic ML publication gate and documented the future peer matrix requirement.
findings.verification: Both cases explicitly report suppressed descriptive grouping; no ML narrative is promoted.

findings.evidence: The app now exposes opponent selection, a Dead-ball Lab, capability warning, five tabs, and a unified evidence room for corner and free-kick sequences.
findings.reproduction: Run Streamlit AppTest and inspect the five tab labels and evidence filters.
findings.actual_behavior: The app loads both cases without exceptions and opens ordered evidence events for all supported categories.
findings.expected_behavior: An analyst should see what deserves review, why the finding is supported, and what the data cannot verify.
findings.root_cause: The former opening workflow was centered on a corner-only module.
findings.impact: The previous UI undersold the broader opponent-preparation workflow.
findings.resolution: Added final-third dead-ball summary, capability copy, restart filters, recurrence fields, and explicit event-only language.
findings.verification: AppTest passes with zero exceptions; mobile CSS remains a documented visual follow-up.
